non_blocking.suggestion: Row 3 ('No provider attempt after reservation ... Nothing, proposed (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15; hits: OQ-ai-llm-gateway-5)') does not say whether it applies now. The sentence after the table says the other two OQ-15 proposals do not apply before it closes, so readers will take row 3 as being in force. Pack 8.9 only says that missing usage charges all of R. State the interim rule explicitly, for example 'Until OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 closes, R is released (proposed interim)', or 'all of R', so a contributor knows what to build for a guardrail block, RZ-AI-004 or a cache hit after reservation.

The guard counts output 'with the attempted candidate's correction'. A correction above 1 (for example about 1.3 for Claude Opus 4.7 and later) inflates the local count, so a valid response can end with RZ-AI-008 at roughly C divided by the correction in real tokens, before the provider's own cap. Add one sentence saying this truncation risk is why OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 proposes a tolerance, so operators know what to expect while that OQ is open.

The document calls `ruralz_ai_abandoned_attempts_total`, `ruralz_ai_failed_attempts_total`, `ruralz_ai_semantic_cache_store_skipped_total` and the `abandoned`, `error_status` and `oversized` reasons 'New proposals', but 10-observability.md already registers all of them (L376, L379, L382). Say 'adopted' instead. Observability's store-skipped reasons (error, truncated, blocked, size_limit, queue_full) also have no value for the Semantic Cache 'Storage' skips at a partition or principal cap, above the per-Node store rate or above the memory watermark. Propose those reason values.

non_blocking.section: Unified API (Native passthrough); Prompt caching and semantic caching (Prompt Cache)
non_blocking.suggestion: Native passthrough keeps only `content-type`, `accept` and `anthropic-version`, so it strips every `anthropic-beta` header until OQ-ai-llm-gateway-14 closes. Any beta-gated caching feature will therefore fail or be ignored even though the `cache_control` bytes arrive intact (research ai-gateways.md mentions the `prompt-caching-scope-2026-01-05` beta header). Add a clause to the Prompt Cache guarantee saying that it covers the markers but not beta-gated behavior.
